column1: 30351§conceptualize§kənˈseptʃuəlaɪz§v. 将…概念化；构思§Rafael Núnez and colleagues studied how members of the Yupno, an Indigenous group in Papua New Guinea, conceptualize time.§Rafael Núnez 及其同事研究了巴布亚新几内亚原住民群体尤普诺人如何**概念化**时间。§In an anthropology paper, a student claims that the tendency toward ego-based conceptualizations of time is universal.§在一篇人类学论文中，一位学生主张：以自我为参照的时间**概念**倾向具有普世性。§§conceptualize time / a problem 将时间概念化 / 构思问题（真题直接接宾语）；conceptualization n. 概念化（真题名词形）；conceptual adj. 概念上的§conceptualise 是英式拼写，与 conceptualize 为同一词§原书错：辨析用「≠」对比 conceptualize 与 conceptualise，实为同一词的美式 / 英式拼写

30352§elude§ɪˈluːd§v. 躲避；逃避；（答案、道理）难倒，使无法理解§A conclusive demonstration of the logical certainty of the Marden tameness conjecture, posed in 1974, eluded mathematicians until Ian Agol presented a proof of the conjecture in 2004.§1974 年提出的「马尔登驯服猜想」，其逻辑必然性的确凿证明一直**难倒**数学家们，直到 2004 年伊恩·阿戈尔给出了这一猜想的证明。§§§拉丁 e-（出）+ ludere（玩）→「玩着脱身」§elusive adj. 难以捉摸的；难以达到的（renders the final homecoming elusive 使最终归乡难以企及）；elusion n. 逃避§熟词僻义：问题、答案「躲着」人，即难倒、想不出；allude v. 暗指，拼形易混§改例句：删去句末中文注，空格填上正确选项 eluded；改译文：按填好的句子重译，删去括号说明

30353§conducive§kənˈdjuːsɪv§adj. 有助于…的；有利于…的§Some astrobiologists have proposed that brine—water with a concentration of dissolved solids of more than 3.5%—may present conditions conducive to the evolution of life on extraterrestrial bodies.§一些天体生物学家提出，卤水——即溶解固体浓度超过 3.5% 的水——可能为地外天体上生命的演化提供**有利**条件。§§§conduce v. 导致 / 有助于 → conducive adj.§be conducive to 有助于；conditions conducive to X 有利于 X 的条件（科学阅读固定搭配）§通常作表语或后置定语§

30354§conjecture§kənˈdʒektʃə(r)§n. 推测；猜测；猜想 v. 推测；猜测§though it seemed to many mathematicians, the honeycomb conjecture, posited in the first century BCE, eventually yielded to the efforts of Thomas C.§……尽管在许多数学家看来似乎如此，公元前 1 世纪提出的蜂巢**猜想**最终还是在 Thomas C.……的努力下被攻克。§§§§the honeycomb conjecture 蜂巢猜想（真题）；ponder conjectures about… 琢磨关于…的种种猜想；conjectural adj. 推测性的；speculation n. 推测；surmise n. 臆测（近义）§conjecture（无充分证据的推测）≠ inference（有依据的推断）；数学中指尚未证明的「猜想」§改例句：删去句首零宽字符和空格；改译文：原译是另一段（《简·爱》）的翻译，按英文重译

30355§connotation§ˌkɒnəˈteɪʃn§n. 内涵；隐含意义；（附带的）感情色彩§Thus, Apichatpong's description of his films is not self-deprecation; rather, his work invites sleep and thereby strips the description of its negative connotation.§因此，阿彼察邦对自己影片的描述并非自贬；相反，他的作品引人入睡，从而剥离了这一说法原本的负面**含义**。§§§§negative connotation 负面含义§指词语附带的评价或情感色彩，与 denotation（字面义）相对；也指符号、姿态或行为所暗示的意味§

30356§corroborate§kəˈrɒbəreɪt§v. 证实；佐证；印证§Prabuddha De et al. found that a recommender system (RS)—an algorithm that generates personalized product suggestions for online shoppers—impacted consumer behavior and increased sales, a result that was corroborated by Dokyun Lee and Kartik Hosanagar.§Prabuddha De 等人发现，推荐系统（一种为网购者生成个性化商品建议的算法）会影响消费者行为并提升销售额，这一结果得到了 Dokyun Lee 与 Kartik Hosanagar 的**佐证**。§§§§corroborate a claim 证实某一说法；be corroborated by 得到…的印证（真题）§指用独立证据支持某一说法，或另一项研究得出相同结果而互相印证；古义「使（论点、信念）更牢固」§

30357§cryptography§krɪpˈtɒɡrəfi§n. 密码学；加密技术§In this way, Feinstein and others like her helped make it possible for more women—such as Anna Lysyanskaya, who currently works in and teaches digital cryptography—to enter the field of cryptology.§就这样，范斯坦和她那样的人让更多女性得以进入密码学领域——比如目前在数字**密码学**领域工作并任教的 Anna Lysyanskaya。§§§crypto-（隐藏）+ -graphy（写）§digital cryptography 数字密码学（真题）；cryptology n. 密码学（广义）；cryptologist n. 密码学家；cryptic adj. 隐晦的；encrypt v. 加密§同句 cryptology 指广义的密码学领域，cryptography 侧重加密技术§

30358§daze§deɪz§v. 使茫然；使眩晕 n. 迷乱；茫然§The Mole is dazed after briefly meeting a stranger while traveling with a friend. (The) Mole stood still a moment, held in thought.§鼹鼠在和朋友同行时短暂遇见一个陌生人后有些**发懵**。鼹鼠站着愣了一会儿，陷入沉思。§§§§be dazed by / after 因…而发懵；in a daze 茫然；dazed adj. 茫然的；眩晕的（真题以此形出现）§daze ≠ dazzle（使目眩），形近异义；真题只取「发懵」义§

30359§ambivalent§æmˈbɪvələnt§adj. （态度、情感）矛盾的；摇摆不定的§The poem highlights an ambivalence toward poetry as the speaker acknowledges its merits while also expressing a sense of displeasure.§这首诗凸显了对诗歌的**矛盾态度**：说话者一方面承认诗歌的价值，一方面又流露出不悦之感。§§§ambi-（两边）+ val（价值）+ -ent →「两头都有价值」§ambivalence n. 矛盾心理（真题 6 次里 3 次是这个名词形）；ambivalently adv. 矛盾地§ambiguous adj. 模棱两可的，只是前缀 ambi- 相同，侧重含义不明；ambivalent 侧重情感两难§删评论；原书错：说 ambiguous 与它同根 val-，ambiguous 来自 ambi- + agere（驱使），只是前缀相同

30360§debilitate§dɪˈbɪlɪteɪt§v. 使衰弱；使虚弱；削弱（机构、经济等）§In the play, Odysseus and Neoptolemus must retrieve Philoctetes—a master archer who is believed necessary for the Greeks to win the Trojan War—from a cave on the deserted island of Lemnos where Odysseus and others had abandoned him with a debilitating injury earlier in the war.§剧中，奥德修斯与涅俄普托勒摩斯必须把菲罗克忒忒斯——一位被认为对希腊人赢得特洛伊战争不可或缺的神射手——从利姆诺斯荒岛的洞穴里带回；战争早期，奥德修斯等人正是把他连同那处**使人衰弱**的伤口遗弃在了那里。§§§§a debilitating injury / illness 使人衰弱的伤 / 病；debilitating adj. 使人衰弱的（真题以此形出现）；debilitated adj. 衰弱的；debility / debilitation n. 衰弱；enervate v. 使无力；incapacitate v. 使丧失能力（近义）§§

30361§decease§dɪˈsiːs§n. （法律、公文用语）死亡 v. 死亡；去世§Support for the argument that a “consumer revolution,” in which possession of consumer goods among an increasingly wide range of socioeconomic groups surged despite only marginal wage growth, occurred in England between 1600 and 1750 has largely hinged on scholars’ analyses of probate inventories (detailed legal records of deceased persons’ possessions).§「1600 至 1750 年间英格兰发生过一场消费革命」——即尽管工资仅微幅增长，消费品却在越来越广泛的社会经济群体中大幅普及——这一论点，其依据主要来自学者对遗嘱认证清单（详细记录**已故**者财产的法律文书）的分析。§§§§deceased adj. 已故的 n. 死者（deceased persons' possessions 死者的财物）；probate inventories 遗嘱认证清单（详尽记录死者财物的法律文书，真题）§decease ≠ disease（疾病），注意拼写§改译文：漏译 an increasingly wide range of

30362§decompression§ˌdiːkəmˈpreʃn§n. 减压；卸压；（潜水员的）减压§They compared ALF's hydrogen volumetric capacity when using a pressure-temperature swing adsorption (PTSA) process—in which gas is subjected to high pressure and low temperature, allowing its adsorption for storage, and is released by decompression and heating (to 5 bar and 296 K, respectively, in Evans et al.'s study)—to the volumetric capacity of tanks using a standard hydrogen-compression process under 100 bar and 25 bar of pressure and various minimum temperatures.§他们比较了 ALF 在采用变温变压吸附（PTSA）工艺时的氢气体积容量——该工艺把气体置于高压低温下使其吸附储存，再通过**减压**与升温（在 Evans 等人的研究中分别为 5 bar 与 296 K）把气体释放出来——以及采用 100 bar、25 bar 标准压缩工艺与不同最低温度的储罐的体积容量。§§§§decompression sickness 减压病；decompress v. 减压；compress v. 压缩（真题两形同现）；compression n. 压缩（反义，真题科技类高频）；pressure-temperature swing adsorption (PTSA) 变温变压吸附（真题术语）§§改例句：pressure- 后多余空格

30363§defoliate§ˌdiːˈfəʊlieɪt§v. 使落叶；摘除…的叶子；（牲畜）啃光叶片§Because they selectively defoliate certain preferred plant species, grazing livestock are a potential source of ecosystem disturbance.§由于放牧牲畜会有选择地**啃光**某些偏好的植物种类的叶片，它们构成了生态系统扰动的一个潜在来源。§§§§defoliation n. 落叶；去叶；foliage n. 叶丛；foliate adj. 有叶的（同根 foli- 叶）§defoliate ≠ deforest：后者是「砍伐森林」§

30364§demonstrative§dɪˈmɒnstrətɪv§adj. （感情）外露的；（语法）指示的§Chance travellers might praise or pet him; but he was cold under it all, and from a too demonstrative man he would get up and walk away.§偶然路过的旅人也许会夸他、摸摸他；可他对这一切都很冷淡，遇到一个感情过于**外露**的人，他便起身走开。§§§§a demonstrative person 感情外露的人；demonstrative pronoun 指示代词；demonstrate v. 展示；论证；demonstration n. 展示；示威；demonstratively adv. 外露地；reserved adj. 含蓄的；undemonstrative adj. 不露声色的（反义）§demonstrative（感情外露）≠ demonstrable（可证明的）；「指示的」为同形异义§

30365§superficial§ˌsuːpəˈfɪʃl§adj. 表面的；肤浅的；浅表的§Her other major novels consist mainly of scenes of everyday life and describe their characters' interior states in great detail, whereas Orlando propels itself through a series of fantastical events and considers its characters' psychology more superficially.§她的其他主要小说大多由日常生活场景构成，对人物内心状态的刻画细致入微；而《奥兰多》则由一连串奇幻事件推进，对人物心理的处理较为**浮光掠影**。§§§拉丁 superficies「表面」= super-（上面）+ facies（脸；面）§superficially adv. 浅表地；surface n. 表面（同源）§superfluous adj. 多余的，拼形相近、意思不同§改音标：美音 ər 改为英音 ə；原书错：构词写 super- + fic（面、做），实为 super- + facies（脸、表面）

30366§destitute§ˈdestɪtjuːt§adj. 完全没有…的；赤贫的；一无所有的§The knowledge, communicated by the historian and biographer, is analogous to that which we acquire of a country by the map,—minute, perhaps, and accurate, and available for all necessary purposes, but cold and naked, and wholly destitute of the mimic charm produced by landscape painting.§历史学家与传记作者所传达的知识，类似于我们通过地图获得的对一国的了解——或许细致而准确，足以应付一切必要用途，却是冰冷而赤裸的，**全无**风景画所带来的那种拟真的魅力。§§§§destitute of 完全没有…（书面语）；the destitute 穷人；destitution n. 赤贫；匮乏；devoid of / bereft of 全无…的（近义）§真题取「缺乏」义，不是「贫穷」义§

30367§determinism§dɪˈtɜːmɪnɪzəm§n. 决定论§Because they accommodate multiple potential outcomes, such models may seem incompatible with causal determinism—the view that particular outcomes are inevitable given certain preconditions.§由于这类模型容纳多种可能结果，它们似乎与因果**决定论**不相容——决定论认为，给定某些前提条件，特定结果就是不可避免的。§§§§causal determinism 因果决定论；be incompatible with determinism 与决定论不相容（真题）§哲学立场：一切结果都由先前条件必然决定，自由意志只是错觉；也指技术或环境单向塑造社会文化的理论§

30368§dignify§ˈdɪɡnɪfaɪ§v. 使有尊严；使显得庄重；给…抬高身价§He determined to pursue the career of ornithologist; there was something so dignified and withal scientific about a science that called the sparrow Passer domesticus and the robin Erithacus rubecula.§他决意以鸟类学家为业；一门把麻雀叫作 Passer domesticus、把知更鸟叫作 Erithacus rubecula 的学问，是那样**庄重**而同时又那样科学。§§§§dignify a subject 使题材显得庄重；not dignify sth with a reply 不屑回应；dignity n. 尊严；dignified adj. 庄严的（真题以此形出现）；dignitary n. 显要人物§dignify ≠ indignant：后者是「愤慨的」§

30369§disparate§ˈdɪspərət§adj. 迥然不同的；全异的；不相关联的§Irrational juxtaposition of disparate elements is a central aspect of surrealist collage.§将**迥异**元素作非理性的并置，是超现实主义拼贴的核心面向。§§§§disparate fields / sources 迥异的领域 / 来源；disparity n. 悬殊；差异（真题社科类高频）；disparately adv. 各不相同地§disparate（性质悬殊）≠ desperate（绝望的），SAT 高频形近陷阱；disparate ≠ separate：后者只是「分开的」§改例句：juxtaposition or 应为 of，删去句末多余的「 .」；改译文：原译照错字译成「或」，按 of 改译

30370§satiate§ˈseɪʃieɪt§v. 使满足；使饱足（欲望、胃口）§From sculptures like Miró's Chicago by Joan Miró, found at Brunswick Plaza, to street art like Kristen Kula's mural Tornado on East 11th Street, Chicago offers an array of works to satiate the tastes of art lovers.§从布伦瑞克广场上琼·米罗的雕塑《米罗的芝加哥》，到东 11 街克里斯滕·库拉的壁画《龙卷风》，芝加哥提供了琳琅满目的作品，足以**满足**艺术爱好者的品味。§§§拉丁 satis「足够」，satisfy、saturate 同源§insatiable adj. 无法满足的；贪得无厌的；satiation n. 满足；饱足§近义 satisfy、sate§改例句：删去句末中文注，空格填上正确选项 satiate；删评论；改译文：雕塑名是 Miró's Chicago（《米罗的芝加哥》）；原书错：说 sate 是它的缩短形，sate 来自古英语，只是后来受它影响

30371§dissension§dɪˈsenʃn§n. 意见分歧；纷争；不和§Though the authorship of most of the individual essays is certain, that of a few is in question: for instance, while No.6, “Concerning Dangers from Dissensions between the States," was surely penned by Hamilton, No.52, "The House of Representatives," may have been written by either Hamilton or Madison.§尽管大部分单篇文章的作者身份确定，仍有少数存疑：例如第6篇《论各州之间**纷争**之危险》肯定出自汉密尔顿之手，而第52篇《众议院》则可能由汉密尔顿或麦迪逊所写。§§§§dissension between the states / within a group 各州之间 / 团体内部的纷争；dissent n./v. 异议；dissenter n. 持异议者；discord n. 不和；strife n. 争斗（近义）§dissension（内部的意见不合）≠ dissent（持异议，可作动词）；标准拼写为 -sion，不作 dissention§

30372§disuse§dɪsˈjuːs§n. 废弃；不再使用§Episodes in which technologies fall into disuse after a period of adoption, as occurred with the loss of bow-and-arrow technology in northern Europe during the late Paleolithic, are informative for understanding the factors shaping technological development in ancient societies.§技术在被采用一段时间后又遭**废弃**的情形——例如旧石器时代晚期北欧弓箭技术的流失——有助于我们理解古代社会中塑造技术发展的种种因素。§It is one of more than 2,000 disused railroad corridors in the US that have been converted into public trails since the 1960s.§这是美国 1960 年代以来 2,000 多条**废弃**铁路走廊改建为公共步道的一例。§dis-（取消）+ use§fall into disuse 逐渐被弃用（固定搭配）；disused adj. 废弃的；obsolescence n. 过时；淘汰（近义）§disuse ≠ misuse（误用）/ abuse（滥用），形近异义§改例句2：句末多一个句点

30373§divergence§daɪˈvɜːdʒəns§n. 分歧；背离；分化；偏离§Many have attributed this divergence to the nearly 3,500‑mile‑long “dingo fence,” a barrier installed to prevent access to livestock, that created a division of Australia into large southeast and northwest sections around 150 years ago.§许多人把这一**分歧**归因于那条近 3,500 英里长的「野狗围栏」——这道屏障用于阻止野狗接近牲畜，约 150 年前把澳大利亚分割成东南与西北两大区域。§Despite the marked divergence of such ballads as "The House Carpenter" from their antecedents in Britain, the balladry of the Appalachian South long figured as a proxy for the music naturalized there in the colonial era.§尽管《木匠之家》这类歌谣已与其英国原型明显**分化**，阿巴拉契亚南部的歌谣传统长期被视为殖民时代本地化音乐的替代物。§§divergence of opinion 意见分歧；diverge v. 分歧；分化§指观点、数据、路径之间的背离；生物学指同一祖先谱系分化为不同支系；数学、物理指与标准值的偏离量§改译文：prevent access to livestock 是阻止野狗接近牲畜，原译误作阻止牲畜进入

30374§drudge§drʌdʒ§n. 做苦工的人；苦役 v. 干苦活；做单调乏味的苦差§… thinking of the drudging lot …§……想着那**苦役**般的命运……§§§§drudge at sth 埋头干苦活；the drudging lot of the laboring man 劳动者苦役般的命运（真题以 drudging 作形容词）；drudgery n. 苦役；枯燥繁重的工作；toil n. 辛劳；grind n. 苦差（近义）§§改译文：英文只是中间片段，删去英文里没有的前后部分

30375§egocentric§ˌeɡəʊˈsentrɪk§adj. 以自我为中心的；以自身为参照的§Previous research has found a tendency in many cultures to make temporal distinctions using spatial concepts and gestures, particularly along egocentric axes (i.e., relative to the orientation of the speaker): for instance, English speakers often refer to the front/back axis to describe events in time.§此前研究发现，许多文化都倾向于用空间概念与手势来区分时间，尤其沿着**以自我为参照**的轴（即相对于说话者自身的朝向）：例如，英语使用者常借助前 / 后轴来描述时间中的事件。§§§§egocentric axes 以说话者自身朝向为参照的轴（真题）；egocentrism n. 自我中心主义；allocentric adj. 以他物 / 环境为参照的（真题对立概念）；ego n. 自我§egocentric（认知上以自我为参照）≠ egoistic / selfish（道德上自私）§改例句：front /back 多余空格；改译文：原译「未来在前、过去在后」是引申解释，按英文 refer to the front/back axis 改译

30376§eject§ɪˈdʒekt§v. 喷出；弹出；射出；驱逐；逐出§No other known heating mechanism on Jupiter could account for the formation of this anomalous structure, so one hypothesis considered was that it was ejected from the auroral region toward the equator.§木星上已知的其它加热机制都无法解释这一异常结构的形成，于是有假说认为：它是从极光区向赤道方向被**喷射**出来的。§FDM printers eject a modeling medium through a heated nozzle to build an object layer by layer.§FDM（熔融沉积成型）打印机通过加热喷嘴**挤出**成型介质，逐层堆建物体。§§be ejected from 从…喷出；ejection n. 喷出；弹出；expel v. 排出（近义，真题亦现）§eject、inject、reject、object 同根 ject-（投掷），常混考§改例句2：句末多一个句点

30377§elapse§ɪˈlæps§v. （时间）流逝；过去§After 60 years had elapsed, most of the seeds in those bottles stopped germinating, but Verbascum seeds have remained viable, including those from a bottle dug up in 2021 by Margaret Fleming, Matthew Chansler, and colleagues.§六十年**过去**后，那些瓶子里的种子大多停止了萌发，但毛蕊花（Verbascum）种子仍保持活性，包括 Margaret Fleming、Matthew Chansler 及其同事2021年挖出的一瓶中的种子。§§§§after 60 years had elapsed 六十年过去后（真题）；elapsed adj. 已过去的（elapsed time 经过的时间）；pass / go by 流逝（通用近义）§elapse（时间过去，主语是时间）≠ lapse（失效、陷入；n. 间隔）§

30378§elopement§ɪˈləʊpmənt§n. 私奔§Even when they are sitting they must be on the move; they talk loud on modern topics—on flying machines or the elopement of a society belle.§即便坐着，她们也非动不可；她们高声谈论着时新话题——飞行器啦，某位社交名媛的**私奔**啦。§§§elope（私奔）+ -ment§the elopement of a society belle 社交名媛的私奔（真题）；elope v. 私奔§elope 特指「（为结婚而）私奔」，不同于一般的 escape§

30379§emigrate§ˈemɪɡreɪt§v. 移居国外；迁出§Many immigrants from north China, where Mandarin is the primary language, reside in the neighborhood of Flushing (part of New York City's borough of Queens) while those who emigrated from south China, where many people speak Cantonese or Fuzhounese as a first language, tend to reside in Chinatown, in the borough of Manhattan.§许多来自以普通话为主的中国北方的移民住在法拉盛（纽约市皇后区的一部分），而那些从中国南方**迁出**的人——当地许多人以粤语或福州话为母语——则多住在曼哈顿区的唐人街。§It is about a group of men who emigrate from the Caribbean to Great Britain after World War II.§它讲述了一群人在二战后从加勒比地区**移居**英国的故事。§§emigrate from A to B 从 A 移居 B；emigrant n. 移出者；emigration n. 移出；immigrant n. 移入者；immigration n. 移入（真题同句对举）§emigrate（从…迁出，接 from）≠ immigrate（迁入…，接 to）≠ migrate（迁徙）§改例句2：句末多余的「 .」

30382§enlist§ɪnˈlɪst§v. 招募；征募；谋求（帮助、支持）；入伍§The researchers tested this hypothesis by enlisting participants in an online game in which they had to correctly identify the meanings of ape gestures seen in videos.§研究者**招募**参与者玩一款在线游戏来检验这一假说：游戏中他们必须正确辨认视频里所见的类人猿手势的含义。§The institute enlisted botanist Janaki Ammal to breed a local variety of sugarcane.§该研究所**延请**植物学家 Janaki Ammal 培育本地的甘蔗品种。§§enlist participants / volunteers 招募受试者 / 志愿者（真题）；enlist the aid of 谋求…的帮助；enlist in the army 参军；enlistment n. 入伍；招募；recruit v. 招募（近义）§§改例句2：句末多一个句点

30384§envision§ɪnˈvɪʒn§v. 设想；展望§Together, they envisioned a theater company that would nurture and showcase the work of Black theater professionals.§他们共同**设想**出一家能够培育并展示黑人戏剧从业者作品的剧团。§§§§envision a future / a company 设想未来 / 一家公司（真题直接接名词宾语）；envisioned 过去式（真题以此形出现）；vision n. 愿景；视力；visionary n. 有远见者§envision 指想象尚未存在之物；envisage（预见、设想）多见于英式英语§

30385§equity§ˈekwəti§n. （品牌）权益；股东权益；公正；公平§Elena Markovic and colleagues examined 203 months of economic data to investigate whether line length mediates the effects of economic expansions and contractions on brand equity (the value, manifesting as a price premium, that a brand has in consumers’ minds due to its perceived quality and other associations).§埃琳娜·马尔科维奇及其同事考察了 203 个月的经济数据，以研究产品线长度是否中介经济扩张与收缩对品牌**权益**的影响——品牌权益是品牌因感知质量及其他联想而在消费者心中具有的价值，表现为价格溢价。§§§§brand equity 品牌权益；equity financing 股权融资；equity in education 教育公平§brand equity 指品牌在消费者心中形成的价值，常表现为价格溢价；金融中与 debt 相对；作「公平」时与 equality 不同，强调按需补偿§改译文：line length 是产品线长度，原译误作句子长度

30386§eschew§ɪsˈtʃuː§v. （有意）避开；回避；摒弃§Now seen as a mechanical precursor to the e-reader, Spanish educator and inventor Ángela Ruiz Robles’s Enciclopedia Mecánica eschewed pages in favor of three horizontal paper scrolls that could be easily swapped out to accommodate a range of subjects.§如今被视为电子阅读器机械先驱的《Enciclopedia Mecánica》，出自西班牙教育家、发明家 Ángela Ruiz Robles 之手：它**摒弃**了书页，代之以三条可轻松更换的水平纸卷，以容纳不同学科的内容。§§§§eschew a tradition / convention 摒弃传统 / 惯例；eschew A in favor of B 弃 A 而取 B（真题）；eschewal n. 回避；shun v. 避开；repudiate v. 拒斥（近义）§eschew 是「出于原则主动不采用」，比 avoid 更书面、更有立场§

30387§evince§ɪˈvɪns§v. 表现出；显示出（性质、情感、风格）§After traveling to the United States and Europe in the early 1930s and immersing himself in a broader architectural discourse, Barragán began incorporating principles derived from functionalism and modernism in his work, as seen in the houses in Avenida Parque Mexico, whose unadorned geometric forms contrast with his earlier projects in Guadalajara, such as the house in Calle Liceo, which evince the aesthetics of traditional Mediterranean and Mexican styles.§20世纪30年代初赴美国与欧洲游历、并沉浸于更广阔的建筑话语之后，巴拉甘开始把源自功能主义与现代主义的原则纳入自己的作品，墨西哥大道公园一带的住宅即为一例：其未经装饰的几何形体，与他在瓜达拉哈拉的早期项目（如 Liceo 街的住宅）形成对照——后者明显**体现**着传统地中海与墨西哥风格的美学。§§§§evince an aesthetic / interest 显示出某种美学 / 兴趣；evinced 过去式（真题亦现）；display v. 展现；manifest v. 表明（近义）§evince（透露出内在特质）≠ evict（驱逐）≠ evoke（唤起）§原书错：搭配说明称 evince 与 evidence / evident 同根，实则前者出自拉丁语 evincere（vincere 征服），后者出自 videre（看）

30388§exactness§ɪɡˈzæktnəs§n. 精确（性）；严谨§These defects are partly remediable, and even without an absolute violation of literal truth, although by methods rightfully interdicted to professors of biographical exactness.§这些缺陷在一定程度上是可以补救的，甚至无须彻底违背字面上的真实，尽管所用的方法理应为那些标榜传记**精准性**的人所禁用。§§§exact + -ness§professors of biographical exactness 标榜传记精准性的人（真题）；exact adj. 精确的；exactly adv. 确切地；exactitude n. 精确；严谨（正式近义词）§§改译文：原译把「无须违背字面真实」和「尽管」的让步关系译乱，按英文改译

30389§expel§ɪkˈspel§v. 排出；喷出；驱逐；开除§Material expelled during these events follows a narrow arc trajectory back to the Sun’s surface.§这些事件中**喷出**的物质沿着一条狭窄的弧线轨迹落回太阳表面。§§§§be expelled from school 被开除；expulsion n. 排出；驱逐；eject v. 喷出（近义，真题亦现）§expel、compel、repel、dispel 同根 pel-（推），常混考§

30390§exponent§ɪkˈspəʊnənt§n. （主张、风格的）代表人物；倡导者；（数学）指数；幂§The microgenre of electronic music known as hyperpop emerged in the 2010s, with American singer Dorian Electra as an early exponent.§被称为 hyperpop 的电子音乐微类型于2010年代兴起，美国歌手 Dorian Electra 是其早期**代表人物**之一。§§§§an early exponent of… …的早期代表人物；exponential adj. 指数的；呈指数增长的；proponent n. 拥护者；practitioner n. 实践者（近义）§exponent（代表人物）≠ opponent（对手）≠ proponent（支持者）；真题取「早期代表」义，不是「指数」§

30391§exquisitely§ɪkˈskwɪzɪtli§adv. 极其；精妙地；精美地§As ectothermic creatures exquisitely responsive to temperature and habitat changes, butterflies serve as nature’s early warning system.§蝴蝶作为变温动物，对温度与栖息地变化**极其**敏感，因而充当着大自然的早期预警系统。§§§§exquisitely responsive to 对…极其敏感（真题）；exquisitely crafted 做工精美的；exquisite adj. 精美的；细腻的；极敏感的§真题取「极其（敏感）」义，不是「精美」§

30392§facsimile§fækˈsɪməli§n. 摹本；复制品；传真§One no longer widely read edition is the 1984 "critical and synoptic edition" edited by Hans Walter Gabler, which followed French and German editorial theories rather than editorial traditions of the United States and United Kingdom and which was later found to have introduced errors due to Gabler's choice to consult facsimile manuscripts rather than using only originals.§如今已不太流行的版本之一，是汉斯·瓦尔特·加布勒编辑的 1984 年校勘与对照版；它遵循法德两国的编辑理论，而非英美的编辑传统，后来被发现因加布勒选择参考**摹本**手稿而非仅使用原件而引入了错误。§§§§facsimile manuscripts 摹本手稿（真题）；send by facsimile 用传真发送；fax n. 传真（facsimile 的缩略）§图书与档案语境指力求还原原件的复制品；通信语境指传真件§

30393§federalist§ˈfedərəlɪst§n. 联邦主义者；（美国史）联邦党人 adj. 联邦主义的§The Federalist Papers are a collection of essays written by Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison and published pseudonymously in the New York Packet and other New York newspapers in 1787-88.§《**联邦党人**文集》是亚历山大·汉密尔顿、约翰·杰伊与詹姆斯·麦迪逊撰写的一组文章，1787至1788年间以笔名发表在《纽约邮报》及纽约其他报纸上。§§§§the Federalist Papers《联邦党人文集》（真题固定译名）；federal adj. 联邦的；federation n. 联邦；anti-Federalist n. 反联邦主义者（真题对举）§federalist 指人或派别，federal 是形容词「联邦的」§

30394§festoon§feˈstuːn§n. 花彩；彩饰；垂花饰 v. 以花彩装饰§Bradford is driving through the countryside in Florida. The moss in the towering water oaks had become enlivened with a verdant sheen of silver and hung like festoons of carnival or like funeral decorations for the mourning of the dead.§布拉德福德正驾车穿行于佛罗里达乡间。高大的水栎上的苔藓被一层银中带翠的润泽点亮，像狂欢节的**彩饰**，又像为悼亡而悬挂的丧礼装饰，垂挂下来。§§§§be festooned with 挂满…；festooned adj. 挂满花彩的（真题以此形出现）；festoons of carnival 狂欢节的彩饰（真题）；garland n. 花环（近义）§与 festival / festive 形近义相关，但词性不同§改例句：删去句中零宽字符并补空格；改译文：补译漏掉的引导句

30395§foreshadow§fɔːˈʃædəʊ§v. 预示；为…埋下伏笔§This incident leads me to the reflection that sometimes our imagination foreshadows what lies uppermost in our minds and brings possibilities within the sphere of realities.§这件事使我生出这样的感想：有时我们的想象会**预先映出**心头最挂念的东西，并把种种可能性带进现实的范围内。§§§fore-（预先）+ shadow（影子）§foreshadow an event / outcome 预示事件 / 结果；foreshadowing n. 伏笔（文学分析术语）；presage v. 预兆；herald v. 预示（近义）§foreshadow ≠ forestall：后者是「预先阻止」，真题亦现§

30396§forestall§fɔːˈstɔːl§v. 预先阻止；抢先防范§Although beneficial for forestalling loss of vascular function when leaf veins are blocked, reticulate (netlike) leaf-vein topologies in plants are thought to reduce efficiency in water and sugar transport and to increase vein construction costs relative to branched topologies.§植物的网状（网格状）叶脉拓扑虽有利于在叶脉被堵塞时**预先防止**维管功能丧失，但人们认为它会降低水分与糖分运输的效率，并相对于分支状拓扑提高叶脉的构建成本。§§§fore-（预先）+ stall（拦住）§forestall a loss / a crisis 预先防止损失 / 危机；forestalling 现在分词（真题以此形出现）；preempt v. 先发制人；avert v. 避免（近义）§forestall（预先阻止）≠ foreshadow（预示）≠ foretell（预言），三词形近易混§改例句：(netlike) 后漏空格

30397§forgery§ˈfɔːdʒəri§n. 赝品；伪造品；伪造（行为）§Furthermore, nonvisible spectra can be used for chemical analysis to identify specific pigments and thus, in some cases, reveal forgeries: if, for example, titanium oxide—which wasn’t developed until the 20th century—is evident throughout the layers of a painting attributed to an 18th-century artist, that work can only be a forgery.§此外，非可见光谱可用于化学分析，从而识别特定颜料，并在某些情况下揭示**赝品**：例如，若在署名 18 世纪艺术家的画作各层中明显检出二氧化钛——这种颜料直到 20 世纪才被开发出来——该作品就只能是赝品。§§§§reveal forgeries 揭示赝品（真题）；forge v. 伪造§艺术与文物语境指冒充真品的仿作；法律语境指伪造文书、签名或货币§

30398§graze§ɡreɪz§v. （牲畜）吃草；放牧；擦过；轻触§Alessandro Filazzola et al. analyzed data on plant abundance from areas with livestock grazing (control sites) and without it (treatment sites) in Argentina and nineteen other countries and calculated the effect of excluding grazing livestock, where positive values indicated greater plant abundance in treatment sites relative to control sites.§Alessandro Filazzola 等人分析了阿根廷及其他十九个国家中有牲畜**放牧**区域（对照点）与无放牧区域（处理点）的植物丰度数据，并计算了排除放牧牲畜的效应：正值表示处理点的植物丰度高于对照点。§§§§livestock grazing / grazing livestock 牲畜放牧 / 放牧的牲畜（真题高频）；graze the surface 擦过表面；grazing n./adj. 放牧；食草的；pasture n. 牧场；herbivory n. 植食（作用）（真题同域词）§graze ≠ glaze（上釉）/ grate（磨碎），形近异义§

30399§grossly§ˈɡrəʊsli§adv. 严重地；极其§MOMA claims the video presentations are only for games that would be impractical to display in a playable form, but video games are an inherently interactive medium, a feature that is grossly absent in a video-only presentation.§现代艺术博物馆声称，影像展示只用于那些无法以可游玩形式呈现的游戏；可电子游戏本质上是一种交互媒介，而这一特征在纯影像的展示中**严重**缺失。§§§§grossly absent 严重缺失（真题）；grossly inadequate / overstated 严重不足 / 夸大；gross adj. 严重的；总的；粗俗的；gross domestic product 国内生产总值§grossly 是副词，gross 是形容词，勿混§

30400§habitation§ˌhæbɪˈteɪʃn§n. 居住；栖居；住所；聚居地§Zooarchaeologist Ophélie Lebrasseur and her team examined a fox skeleton discovered in 1991 at an archaeological site alongside artifacts of human habitation (like spear points) in central Argentina.§动物考古学家 Ophélie Lebrasseur 及其团队研究了1991年在阿根廷中部一处考古遗址发现的狐狸骨架，它与人类**栖居**的遗物（如矛尖）一同出土。§The researchers hypothesize that the site was a habitation site.§研究者推测该遗址曾是一处**居住**遗址。§§artifacts of human habitation 人类栖居的遗物（真题）；habitation site 居址（考古学术语）；inhabit v. 居住于；habitable adj. 可居住的；habitat n. 栖息地（同根，真题全现）§habitation ≠ habit：后者是「习惯」§改例句2：句末多余的「 .」
